name: app-conversational-planner-chat-screen
title: Conversational planner with amber bubbles and suggestion chips
whatItIs: A rounded warm-grey slide. A phone at left shows a chat where user replies are amber bubbles, the assistant text is plain, six chips (Children, Work...) offer quick answers and a white input has a blue mic button. Copy to the right reads 'Organize your life, just by talking'.
whatItMeans: Friendly and effortless; it turns planning into a chat instead of a form.
techniques: Show assistant text without a bubble and user text in colour so the roles are distinct.
Offer tappable suggestion chips instead of forcing typing.
Use one warm amber for user actions and one blue for voice.
Crop the phone off the top and left so the UI feels large and the copy has room.

vocabulary.definition: A tappable pill offering a quick reply.
An interface that works as a dialogue.
A phone cut by the frame to enlarge the UI.
A microphone control for speaking input.
